Title: Generally Available: Azure Confidential Ledger Achieves SOC 2 Type II Compliance

Body.Content:
Azure Confidential Ledger is now SOC 2 Type II compliant. The SOC 2 Type II certification is a rigorous standard for data security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy. It demonstrates that Azure Confidential Ledger has implemented robust controls and processes to protect customer data.

This compliance is part of our ongoing efforts to meet and exceed industry standards, ensuring that our customers can confidently use Azure Confidential Ledger for their most sensitive and critical workloads.

Learn more:

  • Azure Confidential Ledger 
  • Security Community Webinars
